rows.note: documentLink covers ONLY what goto-def can't reach: a comment URL, POD L<Module> (resolved against the registered universe), POD L<url>. L<No::Such::Module> yields NO link (unresolvable → honest miss, never a guessed target), and `use DL::Target` gets no link at all — module identifiers are goto-def's job. (The https:example.com spelling is the harness path-normalizer eating `//` before `example.com` — raw output carries the full URL.)

`use lib 'lib'` links to the existing dir (root-anchored), `require "helpers/util.pl"` to the existing file; `require "missing/nope.pl"` yields NO link — existence-gated, a wrong-file link is worse than none.
